overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to meet to review an April 10 complaint within 14 business days before responding, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: The Board failed to meet to review an April 10 Open Meeting Law complaint before responding to it by letter dated May 5.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board failed to follow the requirements of both the Open Meeting Law and the Attorney General's regulations.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 9 17 2015 - OML 2015-138 - WARE BOARD OF HEALTH.pdf

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
